chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad narrated from Mu‘allā ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn ‘Alī ibn al-Nu‘mān, from Sandal, from Abū Usāmah, from Abū ‘Abdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

Al-Hasan ibn ‘Alī عليهما السلام set out one year to Makkah on foot, and his feet became swollen. Some of his mawālī said to him, “If you were to ride, this swelling would subside.” He said, “No. When we come to this stopping place, a black man will meet you with oil. Buy it from him and do not bargain with him.”

His servant said to him, “May my father and mother be ransomed for you, we have not come to any stopping place in which anyone sells this medicine.” He said to him, “Yes, indeed; he is before you, short of the stopping place.” So they traveled a mile, and there was the black man. Al-Hasan عليه السلام said to his servant, “There is the man; take the oil from him and give him the price.”

The black man said, “Young man, for whom do you want this oil?” He said, “For al-Hasan ibn ‘Alī.” He said, “Take me to him.” So he went and brought him to him. He said to him, “May my father and mother be ransomed for you, I did not know that you needed this. Do you think I would take a price for it? I am only your servant. But pray to Allah that He grant me a sound male child who loves you, Ahl al-Bayt, for I left my wife while she was in labor.”
He said, “Go to your home, for Allah has granted you a sound male child, and he is among our Shi‘a.”

key_terms.أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ: the Household of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.شِيعَتِنَا: those who follow and adhere to the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.لَا تُمَاكِسْهُ: do not haggle with him over the price

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith show about the virtues of al-Hasan ibn ‘Alī عليه السلام and love for Ahl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates an incident from the life of al-Hasan ibn ‘Alī عليهما السلام during a journey to Makkah, highlighting his foreknowledge and the devotion people held toward Ahl al-Bayt. It also includes a request for du'a for a righteous child and the Imam’s glad tidings that Allah had already granted such a son from among their Shi‘a.
